prereq: Stage 1–3 的恢复、审批、验证、接管和撤销已经稳定。
已明确允许触发主动任务的来源、时间窗口、预算和静默时段。
手机只作为查看、审批、接管和发起入口，不成为默认执行权威。
contracts: 触发幂等
同一来源事件经过去重与窗口聚合，不能生成重复主动任务。
审批安全
手机审批绑定参数、nonce、设备与过期时间；重新认证后才能确认。
通知隐私
推送只包含脱敏摘要，不泄露正文、附件、凭据或完整任务上下文。
注意力预算
用户可设定安静时段、打断上限和主动级别；预算耗尽立即停止。
可撤销性
任何主动模式、设备和通知权限都能暂停、降级或撤销，并留下审计。
failures: 重复触发导致通知轰炸
聚合为一个候选卡并标注重复来源。
提高去重窗口、暂停触发或降低主动级别。
审批拒绝并显示设备/时间不匹配。
要求重新认证并重新生成审批请求。
主动任务停在预算边界，显示已停止原因。
等待用户提高预算或手动继续，不自动透支。
exclusions: 不在没有恢复、审批和验证的前提下开放主动循环。
不为了活跃度制造任务或通知。
不把手机变成长期持有主凭据的执行设备。

prereq: Stage 1–3 recovery, approval, verification, takeover, and revocation are stable.
Allowed triggers, time windows, budgets, and quiet hours for proactive work are explicit.
The phone is an entry for viewing, approval, takeover, and initiation, not the default execution authority.
contracts: Trigger idempotency
Each source event passes deduplication and window aggregation and cannot create duplicate proactive tasks.
Approval safety
Mobile approval binds parameters, nonce, device, and expiry; reauthentication precedes confirmation.
Notification privacy
Push contains only redacted summaries, never body text, attachments, credentials, or full task context.
Attention budget
Users set quiet hours, interruption limits, and proactivity level; exhaustion stops work immediately.
Revocability
Proactive mode, devices, and notification permission can all pause, degrade, or revoke with an audit trail.
failures: They collapse into one candidate card with duplicate sources marked.
Widen the deduplication window, pause triggers, or lower proactivity.
Approval is rejected with a device/time mismatch.
Require reauthentication and generate a new approval request.
The proactive task stops at the budget boundary and explains why.
Wait for the user to raise budget or resume manually; never overspend.
exclusions: Do not enable proactive loops without recovery, approval, and verification.
Do not manufacture tasks or notifications to look active.
Do not make the phone a long-term credential-holding execution device.

zh.title: Trigger 与主动收件箱
zh.lead: 让系统先提出“现在可以做什么”，但每一次建议都要有来源、预算、打扰级别和明确暂停入口。
zh.outcome: Hearth 能提出可执行的主动建议，说明触发原因、建议动作、预算和是否会打扰用户。
steps: 接入邮件、日历、文件和任务依赖 Trigger，记录来源事件和去重键。
实现主动候选生成、fast path 和 A1/A2 自主级别。
创建主动任务卡，展示“为什么现在”的来源与建议动作。
加入预算上限、暂停、忽略和降级入口。
保证高风险动作仍需审批，主动建议不能直接扩大权限。
验证重复事件不生成重复任务，预算耗尽会停止。
zh.gate: 重复事件不生成重复任务；主动建议有来源；用户能一键暂停；没有无限后台循环；预算耗尽会停止；高风险动作仍需审批。

en.title: Triggers and the proactive inbox
en.lead: Let the system propose what can be done now, but every suggestion needs provenance, budget, interruption level, and a clear pause.
en.outcome: Hearth proposes actionable proactive work and explains the trigger, suggested action, budget, and whether it will interrupt the user.
steps: Connect email, calendar, file, and task-dependency Triggers with source events and deduplication keys.
Implement proactive candidate generation, fast path, and A1/A2 autonomy levels.
Create proactive task cards explaining Why now and the suggested action.
Add budget limits, pause, ignore, and downgrade controls.
Keep high-risk actions approval-gated; proactive suggestions cannot expand authority.
Verify duplicate events create no duplicate tasks and budget exhaustion stops work.
en.gate: Duplicate events create no duplicate tasks; suggestions have provenance; one-click pause works; no infinite loop; budget exhaustion stops; high-risk actions still require approval.

zh.title: 手机 PWA：查看、审批、接管和发起
zh.lead: 把关键动作带到手机上，但手机只持有短期会话和最小权限，不复制完整的桌面执行环境。
zh.outcome: 用户可以在手机上看到今日任务、需要你、产物，完成审批、接管、发起任务和接收高信号通知。
steps: 实现响应式 PWA，覆盖移动任务卡、审批、接管和产物预览。
加入离线只读缓存，不允许离线确认外部副作用。
使用生物识别或短期会话保护高价值动作。
实现脱敏推送和通知权限管理。
检查单手操作、键盘可达和屏幕阅读器基础可访问性。
验证关键动作可完成且手机不持有长期主凭据。
zh.gate: 关键动作在手机可完成；不持有长期主凭据；离线不产生外部副作用；审批需要重新认证；推送不泄露敏感正文。

en.title: Mobile PWA: view, approve, take over, and initiate
en.lead: Bring key actions to the phone while holding only short-lived sessions and minimum authority, not a copy of the desktop execution environment.
en.outcome: Users see today's tasks, needs-you items, and artifacts on mobile and can approve, take over, initiate, and receive high-signal notifications.
steps: Implement a responsive PWA covering mobile cards, approvals, takeover, and artifact preview.
Add offline read-only cache and prevent offline confirmation of external effects.
Protect high-value actions with biometrics or short sessions.
Implement redacted push and notification permission management.
Check one-hand use, keyboard reachability, and basic screen-reader accessibility.
Verify key actions complete without the phone holding a long-term primary credential.
en.gate: Key actions work on mobile; no long-term primary credential; offline creates no external effect; approvals require reauthentication; push reveals no sensitive body.

zh.title: 安全配对、推送与设备撤销
zh.lead: 手机和桌面必须通过短期配对建立信任，丢失设备时能立即撤销审批、接管和读取权限。
zh.outcome: 手机和桌面通过短期码或二维码配对；手机丢失时可以立即撤销，撤销后无法继续审批或接管。
steps: 实现公钥配对、短期码/二维码和用户确认。
建立安全隧道或推送中继，禁止让中继直接读取任务正文。
审批加入 nonce、参数绑定和过期时间，拒绝重放。
实现设备列表、远程撤销、会话失效和推送摘要。
记录配对、审批、撤销和安全事件审计。
演练丢失设备后的撤销与恢复，确认旧设备无法继续访问。
zh.gate: 审批不可重放；丢失设备可撤销；撤销后任务与产物访问立即受限；推送不含敏感内容；配对不能绕过用户确认。

en.title: Secure pairing, push, and device revocation
en.lead: Phone and desktop must establish trust through short-lived pairing, and a lost phone must immediately lose approval, takeover, and read access.
en.outcome: Phone and desktop pair with a short code or QR; a lost phone can be revoked immediately and can no longer approve or take over.
steps: Implement public-key pairing, short code/QR, and explicit user confirmation.
Build a secure tunnel or push relay that cannot read task bodies.
Bind approvals to nonce, parameters, and expiry and reject replay.
Implement device list, remote revocation, session invalidation, and push summaries.
Audit pairing, approval, revocation, and security events.
Rehearse revoking and recovering after device loss; confirm the old device loses access.
en.gate: Approval cannot replay; lost devices revoke; task and artifact access ends immediately; push has no sensitive body; pairing cannot bypass confirmation.

zh.title: 注意力预算与主动试跑
zh.lead: 主动模式的成败不只看任务数，而看每次打扰是否值得；用预算、静默时段和对照试跑决定是否保留。
zh.outcome: 主动模式可以安静地工作，只在真正需要时出现；用户可以预测何时会被打扰，并能随时降级。
steps: 实现注意力预算、静默时段、聚合通知和价值评估。
记录每个任务的平均打断次数、成功率与用户满意度。
提供主动模式开关、强度级别和 kill switch。
运行 shadow/对照试跑，比较主动与手动触发的价值。
分析通知疲劳、误触发和真正需要人工的情况。
根据结果决定扩大、保持或回退主动范围。
zh.gate: 每个任务平均打断次数 ≤ 1；主动任务产生真实价值；没有通知疲劳；用户能解释为什么被提醒；可以随时暂停、撤销或降级主动模式。
evidence: 注意力预算与静默设置
主动模式 kill switch 演示

en.title: Attention budget and proactive trial
en.lead: Proactive success is not task volume but whether each interruption is worth it; use budgets, quiet hours, and a control trial to decide.
en.outcome: Proactive mode works quietly and appears only when needed; users can predict interruptions and downgrade at any time.
steps: Implement attention budgets, quiet hours, notification aggregation, and value evaluation.
Record average interruptions, success rate, and satisfaction per task.
Provide proactive mode, intensity levels, and a kill switch.
Run shadow/control trials comparing proactive and manually triggered value.
Analyze notification fatigue, false triggers, and genuine human-need cases.
Use results to expand, hold, or revert proactive scope.
en.gate: Average interruptions per task ≤ 1; proactive tasks create real value; no notification fatigue; users can explain why they were notified; pause, revoke, or downgrade works.

zh.title: Stage 4 发布
zh.lead: 以低打扰、可撤销、手机可处理关键动作作为发布标准，而不是以后台运行时间或任务数量证明主动性。
zh.outcome: 一个低打扰、可通过手机处理关键动作的主动个人 Agent。
steps: 跑代表性 Trigger 场景和真实主动任务试跑。
评估通知疲劳、审批安全、跨设备审计和预算控制。
补齐隐私说明、紧急停止文档和主动模式已知限制。
验证手机审批与接管在真实网络波动下仍然安全。
完成 Stage 4 安全与评测报告，记录主动价值与打断成本。
确认主动模式可暂停、回退，且没有后台预算透支或失控循环。
zh.gate: Stage 4 退出条件全部满足；手机审批与接管稳定；主动模式可暂停和回退；无后台预算透支或失控循环。
evidence: 主动任务价值/打断评估

en.title: Stage 4 release
en.lead: Release on low interruption, revocability, and safe mobile handling of key actions, not on background uptime or task count.
en.outcome: A low-interruption personal agent whose critical actions can be handled on a phone.
steps: Run representative Trigger scenarios and real proactive task trials.
Evaluate notification fatigue, approval safety, cross-device audit, and budget control.
Complete privacy guidance, emergency-stop documentation, and known proactive limits.
Verify mobile approval and takeover remain safe under real network fluctuation.
Publish the Stage 4 safety and evaluation report with proactive value and interruption cost.
Confirm proactive mode pauses, rolls back, and has no budget overspend or runaway loop.
en.gate: All Stage 4 exits hold; mobile approval and takeover are stable; proactive mode pauses and rolls back; no background overspend or runaway loop.
